verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost pixel-identical. The only difference is a slightly different crop of the top-right decorative ring. Both are a uniform scale-down of the original rather than a real rearrangement. In both, the 'USE CODE / TO GET A DISCOUNT' fine print is tiny at 300px wide, the 'LINK IN BIO' button text is hard to read, and there is an empty band of about 70px under the CTA while the skates and headline are packed into the top. 'ICE' still overlaps the skate blade, as it does in the original.
